data.additional_information:
We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to own the design, analysis, and release of mechanical subsystems across our UAV, USV, UUV, and UGV platforms. The role spans 3D modelling, structural and FEA analysis, design for manufacturing (DFM) for plastics, sheet metal, machining, and composites, and direct collaboration with the manufacturing floor. 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
1. Design and Development: Design and develop mechanical components, structures, and subsystems for UAVs / UGVs / USVs / UUVs and robotic platforms using CATIA V6 / SolidWorks. Optimise for weight, strength, manufacturability, and integration with electronics, propulsion, and payloads. 
2. Structural & FEA Analysis: Perform linear, non-linear, vibration, fatigue, and impact analysis using ANSYS / Dassault Simulia (Abaqus). Validate components against load cases derived with the aerodynamics and dynamics teams. 
3. Composites & Lightweight Structures: Contribute to laminate design, ply layups, and composite structural optimisation for airframes, hulls, and pressure-bearing parts. Work closely with the composites manufacturing team on layup, mould, and curing strategies. 
4. Prototyping, Testing & Iteration: Drive build of prototypes through 3D printing, machining, and composite layup. Plan and witness physical tests (static, vibration, drop, environmental) and feed back results into design revisions.
5. Structural Optimization
- Conduct topology and sizing optimization for weight reduction
- Ensure designs meet stiffness, strength, and manufacturability constraints - Drive lightweighting initiatives across platforms 
6. Field Test Support: Plan instrumentation for field, support field test campaigns, analyse field test data, and close the loop between predictions and measured behaviour. Maintain and continuously improve the vehicle’s performance models. 
7. Documentation & Certification Support: Prepare design notes, technical reports, and certification documents in line with applicable standards (DGCA, MIL-HDBK, STANAG references). 
8. Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams for design intent, specifications, and technical concepts of the product. 
9.IP Development & Knowledge Building: Contribute to Patents and Internal design guidelines 

Skills Required 
1.Strong fundamentals in machine design, strength of materials, mechanics of solids, vibrations, and design of mechanical elements. 
2.Proficiency in 3D CAD (CATIA V6 / SolidWorks) including advanced surface and solid modelling. 
3.Proficiency in FEA tools (ANSYS Workbench /Dassault Simulia (Abaqus) and ability to set up, run, and interpret structural simulations. 
4.Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly across mechanical, autonomy, and electronics teams. 
5.Ability to lead, collaborate, and communicate effectively across disciplines. 
6.Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment. Willingness to learn from and contribute to the knowledge of others

Educational Qualification- M.Tech/M.E/PhD
Required Experience-0-2 yrs

Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
